# S1. Comparison with the baseline ARIMA model

Figure S1. Figure 3 with the baseline ARIMA model included: forecast and evaluation data overlay (row 1) and WIS summaries (row 2) for a subset of locations and forecast dates.

Figure S2. Figure 4 with the baseline ARIMA model included: WIS by model broken down by underprediction, overprediction and dispersion, 50% and 90% interval coverage, and relative WIS by horizon, location and forecast date.

# S2. Epidemic phase

The epidemic phase of each forecast was defined from the change in the final evaluation data over the 28-day forecast period, for hospital admissions by location and for wastewater by site (see Methods).

Figure S3. Epidemic phase by forecast date for each location. Top panel: hospital admissions (7-day rolling sum) from the final evaluation dataset, with each forecast date to 7 days later shaded by the hospital admissions phase over the following 28 days. Bottom panels: log wastewater concentrations at each site, shaded by that site's phase.
